Name: Aiko Fukawa
Story: Tokyo University of the Arts graduate; illustrator and picture-book maker whose work appears on Cozyca Products washi, seals, and lifestyle goods. Official Cozyca artist page lists Instagram @aikofukawa.

Name: Midori Asano
Story: Former graphic designer turned illustrator; warm everyday / European-charm motifs appear on Cozyca foil washi (e.g. My Favorite Mugs). Instagram not confirmed in this batch — left unknown.

Name: Chin (Loidesign)
Story: Co-founder of Loidesign with Mr. Wang; floral, retro, and collage stationery (PET tape, stickers). Handle confirmed via loidesign.store and Pinky Elephant interview.

Name: Pion
Story: Taiwanese illustrator turning drawings into stationery (vellum-style memo stickers, tapes). Site: pion2015.com. Instagram handle not verified this batch.

Name: Some Sort of Fern (羊君)
Story: Illustration brand for masking/PET tapes, stamps, print-on stickers; sold in JP/HK/SG/US/EU shops; featured at Taiwan Creative Expo. Site: somesortoffern.com. IG pending Kura verify.

Name: Chamil Garden (夏米花園)
Story: Rubber-stamp and washi designer under 小徑文化 (Masking-Tape.tw); Round Top (Japan) designer page documents Taiwan base and handmade eraser-stamp practice. IG pending verify.

Name: Oh Mankee (Man Kai-ying)
Story: PolyU design alum; founded Oh Mankee Studio (2021); LIMITS Asian Championship 2022 winner; IP HOKO the Flying Cat with sticker/merch. Instagram linked from ohmankee.com.

Name: Missquai
Story: HK-based illustrator/designer; PolyU + HKBU design training; Hong Kong Young Design Talent; local community and cat motifs; Pinkoi shop. Handle listed on missquai.studio about page.

Name: Hsinyi (GENBOKU)
Story: Illustrator behind GENBOKU (est. 2022); anime-influenced kawaii characters on clothing and artisan goods including vinyl stickers. Site lists IG presence but handle not confirmed this batch.

Name: OURS Studio (森林好朋友)
Story: Founded 2013; watercolor floral, dessert, and forest-animal illustrations across masking/PET tapes, stickers, pins. Official shop ours.tw. Brand Instagram pending Kura verify.
